app.name: Wishlist
app.tagline: A wish list you reveal piece by piece.

register.title: Create account
register.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation email to {email}. Open the link to finish signing up.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.body: We'll send a link for setting a new password.
reset.sent: If an account for {email} exists, the link is in the inbox.

update.title: New password
update.expired: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one.

hero.title: Your list stays yours
hero.body: You decide who sees what. A guest only sees the items you pick.

lists.title: Lists
lists.emptyBody: Create your first list — a birthday, say. It stays private until you share individual items yourself.

fields.title: Title
fields.eventDateHint: Optional. After it we'll offer to wrap things up.

lists.confirmTitle: Delete the list and all items ({n})?
lists.confirmBody: The links you shared will stop working along with the list. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.designHint: v2 has its own screens and its own flow, not just different colors. Switching reopens the app from the start; lists, links and guests' picks are shared by both versions.
settings.highContrastHint: Turns on Charcoal (AAA) and stops list styles from changing it. Overrides everything below.
settings.highContrastSystem: Turned on by your system: the device asks for more contrast. You can turn it off in the device settings.
settings.schemeLocked: While high contrast is on, the scheme doesn't apply. Your choice is kept for when you turn it off.
settings.nichHint: Night is dark by default. You can pick the light theme under Theme.

design.emptyTitle: Design v2 is not here yet
design.emptyBody: The new screens will live here. Your data is fine — it is this version that is empty.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check the inbox.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too short or too simple.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.noResponse: The server is not responding. Please try again.
errors.offline: No internet connection. Your data will appear once you're back online.

common.notFoundBody: The address may be out of date, or have a typo in it.

item.emptyBody: Paste a product link — we will pull the name and price ourselves.

fields.urlHint: Auto-fill arrives in the next step
fields.title: Title

variants.empty: Size, colour, model — what a gift otherwise has to be guessed from.

errors.badUrl: Link must start with http:// or https://
errors.badPrice: Price must be a number of zero or more.
errors.badQuantity: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999.
errors.variantsHalf: Fill in both the label and the value — or remove the detail.
errors.variantsLong: Label up to 40 characters, value up to 80.

item.errorBody: The list itself is fine — only its contents could not be fetched.
item.noResultsBody: The items are still there — filters are hiding them. Drop one or clear them all.
item.resetHint: Clears guests' picks, if there are any, so the item is free again. You won't find out whether there were any — that keeps the gift a surprise.
item.resetConfirmBody: If a guest picked it, the pick disappears and the item is free for everyone again. This can't be undone.
item.resetDone: Item reset: it's free for guests.

export.title: Export list
export.body: Reservations and guest links stay out of the file — they never leave the app.
export.csvHint: Opens in Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets.
export.jsonHint: Also keeps the list name, currency and event date.

import.title: Import list
import.hint: A title column is required. Up to {max} items at a time.
import.pick: Pick a file and you will see exactly what gets created.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than {max} MB.

issues.titleLong: title longer than {max} characters, row skipped.
issues.price: could not read the price “{value}”, left empty.
issues.url: the link in “{field}” does not start with http, field cleared.
issues.noTitleColumn: no title column in the header.
issues.foreignFormat: file from “{format}” — read as much as possible.
issues.eventDate: could not read the date “{value}”, left empty.
issues.tooMany: {count} items in the file, taking the first {max}.
issues.variants: could not read details “{value}”, the field was left empty.
issues.variantsMany: more than five details, the extra ones were dropped.
issues.variantsLong: detail trimmed: label to 40 characters, value to 80.

offline.stale: No connection. Showing a saved copy from {when} — changes will not be saved right now.
offline.title: No connection
offline.savedAt: Showing a saved copy from {when} — changes will not be saved right now.

outbox.pending: Changes waiting for the network: {n}. They will be saved as soon as the connection is back.
outbox.dropped: The server rejected {n} change(s). Check the list — you will have to make them again.
outbox.confirmSignOut: {n} change(s) are waiting for the network. Signing out will discard them. Sign out anyway?
outbox.pendingBody: They will be saved as soon as the connection is back.

parser.partial: Some fields came back empty — fill the rest in yourself.
parser.gotCurrency: Price found in {currency}. Check it against the list currency.

errors.notSignedIn: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.unreachable: Parser is unreachable. Fill the fields in yourself.
errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.blockedHost: That address is blocked for safety reasons.
errors.unsupported: That link isn't an HTML page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
errors.timeout: The shop didn't answer in time.
errors.unknown: Couldn't read that page. Fill the fields in yourself.
errors.authUnavailable: The parser couldn't verify your sign-in. Check its configuration or fill the fields in yourself.
errors.misconfigured: The parser is misconfigured: its Supabase URL is missing.
errors.blockedByShop: This shop blocks automated requests. Copy the name and price in yourself — the link will still be saved.

share.title: My links
share.subtitle: Each one shows only the items you picked. The main list stays private.
share.intro: {n} items will go into this link. The rest of the list stays hidden.
share.linkHint: Anyone with this link sees the selected items. No sign-up needed.
share.emptyBody: Open a list, pick the items and press “Create link”. A guest sees only those.

fields.title: Heading for guests
fields.messageHint: Optional. Everyone who opens the link will see it.
fields.allowReservationsHint: Guests can mark what they're taking. You won't see it — so the surprise holds.
fields.expiresAtHint: Optional. Until the end of that day in your time zone; empty means until you revoke it.

errors.nothingSelected: Pick at least one item first.
errors.expiresInPast: That date has passed — pick today or later.

share.confirmRevokeBody: It stops opening for everyone you sent it to. The stats stay.
share.confirmDeleteBody: The view stats go with it. This cannot be undone.

select.shareActiveOnly: Only active items go into the link: {n}.
select.confirmBody: They also disappear from every link they were in. This cannot be undone.

guest.goneBody: Check the address or ask whoever shared it for a new one.
guest.ownerBanner: This is your own link. Reservations are hidden on purpose — so the gift stays a surprise.
guest.emptyBody: Every item from this link is already unavailable.
guest.footer: This list is private. You only see what was shared with you.
guest.appearanceNote: The list's author chose its look. The color scheme can't be changed here.
guest.raceTitle: Someone took this while you were looking
guest.raceBody: We removed the button so there won't be two identical gifts.
guest.freeEmpty: Nothing is available right now — yours stay here, the rest are under All.
guest.allTakenBody: Other guests have taken every item. No worries: the author may add more, and someone may release theirs.
guest.allTakenBodyMine: You took some, other guests took the rest. The author may add more, and someone may release theirs.
guest.watchHint: We'll remember on this device and show what changed next time you visit. No email needed.
guest.watching: You're watching this list on this device.
guest.changes: Since last time: {new} new, {freed} freed up.
guest.noChanges: Nothing has changed since last time.
guest.keepBody: This link shows what you're taking — to you alone. On another phone without it, your pick will look like someone else's.
guest.codeHint: Or write down the code — it restores your picks anywhere
guest.ownerBlind: The list's author can't see who took what — or whether anything was taken at all.
guest.redeemBody: Enter the code we showed after your first pick. It moves your picks to this device — and keeps them on the old one.
guest.redeemNotFound: That code isn't on this list. Check the letters and digits.
guest.redeemTooMany: Too many attempts for this list. Try again in an hour — until then even the right code won't work.
guest.redeemDone: Picks restored: {n}. They're on this device now too.
guest.noCodeBody: Then your picks stay anonymous: only the list's author can release them — without seeing what they release. Just pick again and save the link this time.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of Wishlist is available.
pwa.installed: Wishlist is already installed on this device.
pwa.installHint: Install Wishlist on your home screen — it will open as a separate app, without the browser bar.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone or iPad, open the site in Safari, tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.installManual: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.qrHint: It is handier on a phone — scan the address.

undo.offline: It will be saved later — there is no connection right now

appearance.title: List style
appearance.guestsSeeBody: The list's style is yours. A guest can't change it — only the light/dark theme and high contrast for themselves.
appearance.name: Name
appearance.namePrivate: Only you see the name. The guest page header shows the list title and date.
appearance.nameEmpty: Give the style a name so you can find it in the list.
appearance.nameEmoji: No emoji: the name sits next to plain text in the list.
appearance.confirmDeleteBody: Lists using it go back to your scheme with no style. This can't be undone.
appearance.a11yLocked: High contrast turns styles off on your screen. Guests without it will see the list styled.
appearance.previewBanner: This is how guests see the list. No reservations here — you never see them, so the gift stays a surprise.
appearance.previewEmpty: No current items yet — there's nothing to share with guests.

sections.noFreeBody: You can't see guests' picks, so there's nothing to filter by. Instead there's “Reset item” in the item dialog if you need to start over.
sections.name: Section name
sections.nameRequired: Give the section a name so guests can find their part of the list.
sections.confirmDeleteBody: Its items won't disappear — they move to “Other”. The section itself and its place in the order can't be restored.

dnd.instructions: To move, press Space or Enter, choose a place with the up and down arrows, press Space or Enter again to drop, or Escape to cancel.

sections.filteredNoDrag: The order can only change without filters: some items are hidden right now.
sections.orderHint: Guests see exactly this order. Drag by the handle to change it.
sections.viewOnlyHint: This is only your view — guests see the order from “Sections”.
sections.saveError: The order wasn't saved. Try again when you're back online.

v2auth.passwordRules: The password doesn't meet the requirements below yet

rules.notEmail: Not the same as your email
rules.notCommon: Not one of the most common passwords

login.title: Your list stays yours
login.lede: Guests see only what you open to them.
login.paused: Three attempts in a row didn't match. Next one in {time}.
login.confirmed: Email confirmed. Now sign in with your password.
login.linkFailed: Signing in via the link or Google didn't work. Try again.

expired.title: This link no longer works
expired.body: The link from the email has expired, was already used, or was opened in a different browser. We'll send a new confirmation email — the old one will stop working.
expired.sent: If {email} isn't confirmed yet, a new email is on its way.

taken.error: An account with this email already exists.
taken.title: Is this you?
taken.reset: Send a link for a new password
taken.resetSent: The email is in your inbox. Open it on this same device — the link works for an hour.
taken.googleHint: Created the account with Google? Then sign in with Google — it has no password.

check.title: The email is in your inbox
check.body: Tap the link in the email sent to {email} — then you can sign in. The link works for an hour.
check.resent: A new email has been sent.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.body: We'll send an email with a link to set a new password. Open it on this same device and in this same browser — elsewhere the link won't work.
reset.sentBody: If an account for {email} exists, the email is already in the inbox. The link works for an hour and only once.

update.title: New password
update.others: Other devices will be signed out.
update.same: That's your previous password — a new one is needed.
update.deadTitle: This link has already been used
update.deadBody: Or more than an hour has passed, or it was opened in a different browser. Send a new one — your email is already filled in.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your email first
unconfirmed.body: You can sign in once {email} is confirmed: the email with the link went there after you signed up. Can't find it? We'll send it again.

lists.title: My lists
lists.stale: No connection. Showing a saved copy from {time}.

templates.title: What occasion are we collecting for?
templates.body: A template only fills in the name — you can change it.

newList.title: New list
newList.name: Name
newList.duplicate: You already have a list with this name. Create another one?
newList.pastDate: This date has already passed — the list will go straight to Past.
newList.draftBody: The name is already filled in. We can save it and you can come back later.

firstRun.title: Where shall we start?
firstRun.body: You can name the list later — what matters is adding the first thing.
firstRun.withItem: Paste a link to a thing
firstRun.withItemHint: We'll pull the name and price from the shop.
firstRun.withList: Create a list for an occasion

v2list.allDone: Nothing open left — purchased and gifted items are below.
v2list.errorBody: The list itself is fine — only its contents couldn't be fetched.

notFound.title: There's no such list
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the address is incomplete. Your other lists are fine.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.body: Paste a link to a product — we'll fill in the name and price.

noResults.title: Nothing for “{q}”
noResults.alsoNoPrice: The “No price” filter is on too.

menuList.inV1: Open this list in the old look
menuList.shareEmpty: Nothing to share yet: the list has no open items.
menuList.exportBody: Export to a file is only in the old look for now.

reorder.subtitle: Your own order — what guests see
reorder.offline: The order can be changed when you are online.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.body: Its items will be gone for good along with the list: {items}.

viewed.one: Its links have been opened {n} time — they will stop working.
viewed.few: Its links have been opened {n} times — they will stop working.
viewed.many: Its links have been opened {n} times — they will stop working.
viewed.other: Its links have been opened {n} times — they will stop working.

delete.typeLabel: Type the list name to confirm

link.label: Link
link.pasteFailed: The browser didn't let us read the clipboard — paste the link into the field.
link.pasteNoUrl: There's no link in the clipboard.
link.bad: This doesn't look like a page address. Check for a missing dot.
link.empty: Paste a link — or type the item in.
link.tooLong: The link is too long — up to 2048 characters.

v2item.readFailed: The shop didn't give a description. The link is saved — fill in the rest by hand.

title.label: Name
title.same: A similar one is already here: {title}

price.label: Price · optional
price.bad: The price is a number: 1240 or 1240.50.

same.title: This is already on the list
same.body: Want two? Better raise the quantity — guests will see how many are needed.

v2share.title: Share
v2share.allowClaims: Guests can mark what they're taking
v2share.allowClaimsHint: So nobody buys twice. You won't see it — the gift stays a surprise.
v2share.previewOf: This is how guests will see the link “{title}”.
v2share.previewNote: The preview updates with every tick. There are no guest marks here — you don't see them anywhere.
v2share.linkHint: Anyone with this link sees the chosen items. No sign-up needed.
v2share.revokeBody: The link will stop working for everyone who got it. Guests' marks stay — a new link will show them the same way.
v2share.revokedBody: The link no longer opens. You can create a new one any time.

v2shares.emptyBody: Open a list, tap “{share}”, pick the items and tap “{create}”. Guests will see only those.
v2shares.copyManual: The browser didn't let us copy automatically — select the address and copy it.
v2shares.subtitle: Each link shows only the items chosen for it. The main list stays private.

v2settings.looksHint: Your own event looks are set on a particular list — in the list menu, “List style”.

data.title: My data
data.body: The file holds all your lists, items and a description of your links. It has no link addresses and no guest marks.

v2settings.deleteLater: Deleting your account will be available here later.
